declaration: length: password has declared column length 60
subject: user_account(password)
rationale: Deployed column is user_account.password VARCHAR(60) (S03), matching the extracted length predicate. Raw passwords longer than 60 characters (61 and 100 chars) sent to /user/registration and /user/savePassword are rejected with 400 by the @ValidPassword Passay LengthRule(8,30) before any SQL is emitted (no insert/update in correlated trace, no row in read-back). The application check is stricter (limit 30, confirmed by the 30-accepted/31-rejected differential). Additionally, every accepted password is transformed by BCryptPasswordEncoder into a fixed 60-char hash (read-backs R01/R07/R08), so the raw value never reaches the column.
limitations: 400 body is Spring's generic ProblemDetail 'Invalid request content.' without field detail: the app's custom handleBindException/handleMethodArgumentNotValid are not real overrides under Spring 6 signatures; cause attributed via length differential (C02 vs C03), not via a field-error message.;The DB length limit itself was never hit because all persisted values are 60-char BCrypt hashes; DB-level enforcement of VARCHAR(60) was not exercised.;/user/updatePassword (authenticated) uses the same @ValidPassword PasswordDto and was not separately exercised.
